newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Backstrom says several advantages to EMU.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Backstrom says several advantages to EMU.

text.p: The governor of Sweden's Riksbank, Urban Backstrom, told Reuters Financial Television on Friday he saw several advantages in Sweden joining the first round of EMU.
Backstrom said Sweden's influence on monetary union would be greater if the country joined EMU from its earliest start date of January 1, 1999.
"Our possiblities to have an impact on the development of the union would be less if we stayed outside."

He acknowledged that many Swedes were reluctant to join EMU. "Many Swedes have a reluctant view on this membership issue but I've also said that, looking at our history, we have always participated in similar arrangements, the gold standard, Bretton Woods and we have had very good experience from doing that.

"I believe that if this issue was discussed more in coming months I think the Swedish population could have the possiblity to make up their minds and not only be reluctant as the case has been so far."
He said he was condifent Sweden would meet EU convergence criteria. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
